notes.title: Update Notes for 19/04/2023
notes.notes: Minor bugfix with one specific achievement failing to unlock.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Responding to player feedback:
- upon finishing the game (by making a fate decision for each character), an unlock will appear in the Settings menu which allows the player to reset the progress for all characters. This will allow you to go back and choose a different fate decision

Thank you!

notes.title: Release day! Thank you!
notes.notes:
Hi folks! Spunsprung here, so excited to release the game today!

This began and ended as a very humble indie project and I'm just so happy to be able to complete that journey for the first time in my life.

Thank you to The Original Curators Group, IL PALLINO and Draconik for their eloquent reviews! And thanks to everyone who helped to support me in their own way!

Cheers! ^^
